model.title: A resolution designating the week of August 2 through August 8, 2026, as "National Farmers Market Week".

summary.text: The resolution designates the week of August 2 through August 8, 2026, as National Farmers Market Week. It also recognizes the important role that farmers markets play in bringing communities together and supporting the livelihoods of many people across the United States, including farmers, food producers, and consumers.
